children: , the Korean AI-memory leader, gained another demand catalyst Wednesday as OpenAI forecast continued growth in advanced-memory requirements. The stock climbed nearly 5% to $194.21.

OpenAI has already signed letters of intent with SK Hynix and Samsung to supply memory for its Stargate infrastructure. Discussions envision the two chipmakers producing as many as 900,000 DRAM wafer starts per month, although neither SK Hynix's share nor firm pricing and purchase commitments have been disclosed. The headline number is enormous. The revenue visibility is not there yet.

The valuation chart flashes the tension clearly: SK Hynix trades 68.85% above its $115.02 GF Value estimate. Second-quarter revenue reached 79.32 trillion won, while operating profit hit 60.54 trillion won for a striking 76% margin, supported by long-term agreements with roughly ten customers. OpenAI strengthens the AI-memory story, but the stock now demands near-perfect executionfresh capacity must turn into durable contracted sales before exceptional margins begin to cool.

title: SK Hynix Jumps Nearly 5% as OpenAI Keeps AI Memory Demand Burning
